               id  The meter id number.
             name  Your name for the meter.
            media  What does the meter measure?
            meter  Meter driver.
        timestamp  Timestamp when wmbusmeters received the telegram. Local time for hr/fields UTC for json.
     timestamp_ut  Unix timestamp when wmbusmeters received the telegram.
     timestamp_lt  Local time when wmbusmeters received the telegram.
    timestamp_utc  UTC time when wmbusmeters received the telegram.
           device  The wmbus device that received the telegram.
         rssi_dbm  The rssi for the received telegram as reported by the device.
         total_m3  The total water consumption recorded by this meter.
   meter_datetime  Date and time reported inside the encrypted manufacturer payload.
   historic_age_h  Age of the last historical reading carried in the telegram.
      historic_m3  The last historical water consumption recorded by this meter.
historic_datetime  Date and time of the last historical reading carried in the telegram.
     frame_status  Status flags stored in the unencrypted manufacturer payload byte.
   current_status  Current alarm and tamper flags from the decrypted payload.
  historic_status  Historic alarm and tamper flags from the decrypted payload.
